page.title: Live Tracking
page.description: Real-time positions of agents on your active shipments

connection.errorBanner: Couldn't reach the live-tracking service. It authenticates on your session cookie (same-site) — if geo-tracker runs on a different domain, a bearer token is required (see env/README.md).

board.truncated: You have more shipments in flight than the map can show at once — some are not listed.
board.etaNoSignal: ETA needs a live position from this agent.

shipment.none: No active deliveries for this agent.

filters.searchLabel: Search tracked agents by name, tracking number or order number
filters.description: Narrows the agent cards. The map always shows everyone.
filters.noMatches: No agents match your search or filter.

empty.title: No agents to track right now
empty.description: Agents appear here while they're delivering an active shipment for your agency.

focus.notBroadcasting: {{name}} isn't broadcasting a live position right now. They'll appear here once they're out on an active shipment.

agent.heading: {{value}}°
agent.trackingEnded: Tracking ended — this delivery is no longer yours to watch.
agent.awaitingPosition: Awaiting a position from this agent.
agent.trackingReauthorizing: Reconnecting — the delivery is unaffected and is almost certainly still in progress.
agent.trackingUnavailable: Live position unavailable right now. Nothing is known about the delivery — retrying.
agent.causeChecking: Finding out why no position is arriving…
agent.causeUnknown: No position is arriving, and the tracking service can't say why.
agent.causeLocationDisabled: Location is switched off on this agent's phone — call them and ask them to turn it back on.
agent.causeLocationPermissionDenied: This agent hasn't allowed the app to use their location — they need to grant it in their phone's settings.
agent.causeTrackingDisabled: This agent has switched location sharing off in the app — ask them to turn it back on.
agent.causeTrackingNotAllowed: This agent hasn't turned location sharing on, so no position can be read for them.
agent.causeDisconnected: This agent's app isn't connected right now — they've most likely lost signal or closed it.
agent.causeNothingReported: This agent's phone hasn't reported anything yet — nothing is known to be wrong, there's simply nothing to show.
agent.causeReporting: This agent is connected and reporting — their next position should arrive shortly.
agent.droppedTimes_one: Their connection has dropped once during this delivery.
agent.droppedTimes_other: Their connection has dropped {{count}} times during this delivery.
